sloka: कांचनम् धरणीम् प्राप्तम् हिरण्यम् अतुल प्रभम् ।ताम्रम् कार्ष्णायसम् चैव तैक्ष्ण्यात् एव अभिजायत ॥१-३७-१९॥
transliteration: kāṁcanam dharaṇīm prāptam hiraṇyam atula prabham ।tāmram kārṣṇāyasam caiva taikṣṇyāt eva abhijāyata ॥1-37-19॥

translations.english: There copper and iron were produced from its acidity, zinc and lead from its residue. Various minerals were formed when that embryo reached the earth.
